welcome.tagline: Isarura Ryiza, Ejo Hazaza Hashyize Umutekano.
welcome.description: IkigoriSmart ni igikoresho cy'ubwenge bw'ikoranabuhanga cyubatswe ku bahinzi b'ibigori. Menya indwara ya MLN hakiri kare, usuzume ibyago by'ikirere mu gihe nyacyo, kandi urinde umusaruro wawe.

step1.title: Fata Ibimenyetso
step1.description: Fungura igikoresho cyo Gusuzuma ufate ifoto nziza y'ikibabi cy'ibigori. Menya neza ko ikibabi kiri hagati kandi ibizere bigaragara neza.
step1.tip: Irinde ibicucu kandi ufate telefone igana ikibabi.

step2.title: Isuzuma rya AI n'Ikirere
step2.description: Porogaramu ikora ibikorwa bibiri icyarimwe: Isuzuma rya CNN rikurikiranira amababi (umuhondo n'ikijuju). Gukusanya amakuru y'ubushyuhe n'ubuhehere hakoreshejwe GPS.

step3.title: Ibisubizo Bihujwe
step3.description: Mu masegonda 3, habwe raporo y'isuzuma ebyombeka igaragaza Ubukana (urugero: Hagati) n'Ibyago byo Gukwirakwira (urugero: Ibyago Byinshi kubera imvura izaza).

step4.title: Inama z'Impuguke
step4.description: Hakurikijwe ibisubizo, porogaramu itanga gahunda ya IPM ijyanye n'ibyo ubona. Ku Hakiri Kare/Hagati: koresha umuti usuzumwe kandi ukurikirane abaturanyi. Ku Bikomeye: randura kandi utwike ibimera byandujwe.

step5.title: Bika & Kurikirana
step5.description: Isuzuma ribikwa ku buryo bwikora mu mateka yawe. Ushobora kugaruka kureba iri suzuma nyuma kugira ngo urebe niba umurima wawe ugenda umera neza ukurikije inama.

q1.question: Ni iyihe MLN kandi kuki ari ikomeye?
q1.answer: Maize Lethal Necrosis (MLN) ni indwara ikomeye iterwa n'ihuza rya virusi ebyiri. Itera amababi y'ibigori guhinduka umuhondo (chlorosis) hanyuma akumira (necrosis). Ni ikomeye kubera ko ikwirakwira vuba binyuze mu budukoko nk'udukoko duto n'udusengenya, kandi niba itavuwe, ishobora gusenya 100% y'umusaruro wawe mu gihembwe kimwe.

q2.question: IkigoriSmart imenya ite 'ubukana' bw'indwara?
q2.answer: Porogaramu ikoresha uburyo bw'ubwenge bw'ikoranabuhanga (CNN) bwahuguwe ku mashusho ibihumbi y'amababi y'ibigori. Ireba ijanisha ry'ibizimba by'umuhondo n'umukara ku kibabi cyawe. Hakiri Kare: Ibizimba bito, ariko ikimera kiracyamera. Hagati: Ibice binini by'umuhondo n'ukumira. Bikomeye: Ikibabi cyashize/umukara, kandi ubuzima bw'ikimera buri mu byago.

q3.question: Kuki porogaramu isaba GPS n'amakuru y'ikirere?
q3.answer: Ikwirakwira rya MLN riterwa cyane n'ibidukikije. Ubushyuhe bwumbuye n'ubuhehere bwinshi bituma udukoko dutwara virusi twiyongera byoroshye. Mu kuhuza isuzuma ry'ikibabi cyawe n'amakuru y'ikirere y'aho uri, IkigoriSmart iragusobanurira atari gusa niba ikimera cyawe kirwaye, ahubwo n'uko bishoboka ko indwara ikwirakwira ku murima wawe wose cyangwa ku baturanyi bawe.

q4.question: Nkora iki niba ibisubizo byange ari 'Bikomeye'?
q4.answer: Niba porogaramu yamenye kwandura gukomeye, igikorwa cyiza gifatwa ni ugurandura ibimera byandujwe ako kanya hanyuma ubikurure kure y'umurima wawe. Ibi bibuza virusi gukwirakwira ku bimera byiza. Porogaramu izatanga 'Ibikorwa byo Gutangira' n'Amahitamo y'Imiti' bijyanye n'amabwiriza agezweho yo mu Rwanda Agriculture Board (RAB).

q5.question: Ndashobora gukoresha porogaramu nta murandamubano?
q5.answer: Urashobora gufata amafoto no kuyabika muri porogaramu mugihe uri hanze. Ariko, kugira ngo ubone Isuzuma rya AI n'Ibyago by'Ikirere, uzakenera guhuza ku murandamubano (3G/4G cyangwa Wi-Fi) kugira ngo porogaramu ivugane na seriveri zacu n'abatanga amakuru y'ikirere.
